children.text: There are many important reasons to hire a personal injury attorney, from having an expert negotiator fighting for you to enjoying greater peace of mind about your future. Selecting the right personal injury attorney is a key part of the process, as not all attorneys offer the same level of care and service. Find the
for you by checking for these five main qualities while you search.

You don’t want to be left in the dark about your personal injury case. The attorney that represents you should prioritize communication with clients, such as by giving you multiple methods of contact and options for getting in touch outside of regular business hours. You should be able to count on frequent updates regarding your case from your lawyers, such as its stage and status.

Your lawyer should also practice openness, honesty, and transparency. You should have a realistic idea of what to expect from your case. How a lawyer communicates can give you an idea of his or her representation style. Effective communication is a skill that your lawyer needs to present a compelling personal injury case to a judge or jury.

Experience is one of the most important things to look for when selecting your personal injury lawyer. Although some law firms offer personal injury representation as an option on a long roster of other types of cases, such as family law or criminal defense, your best choice is an attorney who exclusively practices personal injury law. This will give the law firm and lawyer in-depth knowledge and experience in your practice area. Look for a lawyer that has your type of accident or injury on his or her list of practice areas. This will mean that the attorney has experience specifically handling your type of case.

When meeting with an attorney for the first time, you shouldn’t feel that you are an inconvenience or just one of the hundreds of cases that the law firm is currently working on. A mill-type law firm that is focused on taking as many cases as possible may not be able to dedicate the time or energy that your case deserves. Look for a lawyer that emphasizes quality over quantity. The attorney meeting with you should give you his or her individual attention from the very first consultation. Ask if the attorney you are meeting with is the one who will be handling your case; be wary of law firms that push cases off on paralegals or associates.

Don’t hire a personal injury attorney until you’ve received a clear and accurate estimate of how much his or her services will cost you. Your lawyer should not have any hidden fees or an overly confusing payment arrangement. Your attorney should be able to explain how the law firm charges and give you an estimate based on what your case might require, such as the cost of a case that settles vs. goes to trial. Many personal injury attorneys operate on a contingency fee basis to make legal representation affordable. This means you won’t pay anything upfront and will only owe attorney’s fees if your case ends in financial compensation.

Although past positive results don’t guarantee that an attorney will win your case, a track record of success can show that a lawyer has what it takes to successfully resolve personal injury lawsuits in Colorado. An established history in your community can also mean stronger connections to local experts, judges, and the courts. If you are curious about what an attorney is like when working on a personal injury case, search for reviews and client testimonials for more information.
